---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature for LifePlan
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem this feature would solve.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Describe the use case for this feature:
- **Who** will use this feature? (CEO, Manager, Finance Staff, Cashier)
- **When** will they use it?
- **What** problem does it solve for them?

## Mockups / Examples

If applicable, add mockups, screenshots, or examples of similar features in other apps.

## Priority

How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Important for my workflow
- [ ] Critical — blocking my use of the app

## Additional Context

Add any other context, links, or screenshots about the feature request here.
